summary.result: The study results showed that water and fertilizer treatments are effective in surface load reduction respectively from paddy fields, and, long-term monitoring and evaluation is needed to confirm the reduction.
summary.background: The objective of this study was to investigate the effects of farming methods on mass balance from paddy rice.
summary.method: The three different farming practices were applied: conventional (TR-A), drainage outlet heighten (TR-B) and slow release fertilizer use (TR-C).
